bindings.windows: Vendor-specific WDF/graphics/compute framework binding and runtime
bindings.linux: PCI/platform driver plus vendor compute/DRM subsystem integration
bindings.android: SoC/vendor kernel driver and Android NN/graphics/vendor HAL integration
bindings.macos: Only supported platform/vendor API; confirm DriverKit and entitlement coverage
bindings.freertos: Board/vendor accelerator HAL, memory/cache coherency, queues and interrupt port

virtualization: Requires a vendor model/simulator or dedicated passthrough hardware; generic PCI emulation is insufficient.
